{{Quote|I'm trying to discover what allows these Evocii to survive despite the horrendous pollution. They don't exactly thrive but they are still here, all these years later.|Doctor Terrab|<ref name="Tech" />}}
'''Terrab''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Scientist/Legends|researcher]] residing in the village of [[Voam]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was studying the local [[Evocii]]'s apparent resistance to the planet's pollution. An [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial-aligned]] individual, fulfilling a bounty for [[Suudaa Nem'ro]], acquired a datacore from one of [[Voontara Fa'athra]]'s mining droids and brought it to Terrab for study.<ref name="Tech" />
